reference_context: For purchases above R$5,000, Asteria Systems requires manager approval, Procurement approval, at least 3 competitive quotations, and a Purchase Order before commitment.
Eligible full-time employees receive 20 business days of annual leave per year.
Employees become eligible for annual leave after 90 calendar days of employment.
For domestic travel, meal expenses are reimbursable up to R$120 per day.
Meal reimbursement is based on actual expenses, and alcohol is not reimbursable.
Eligible employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week and must work from the office at least 3 days per week.
Unused remote-work days do not carry over.
The maximum reimbursable hotel rate for domestic travel is R$450 per night.
A domestic hotel rate above R$450 per night requires written director approval.
A receipt is required for expenses of R$50 or more.
For expenses below R$50, a receipt is optional.
Employees must not split expenses to avoid receipt or approval requirements.
Expenses must be submitted within 10 calendar days.
For travel expenses, the 10-calendar-day submission period starts on the employee's return date.
Purchases of R$500 or less require manager approval and do not require competitive quotations.
Purchases above R$500 and up to and including R$5,000 require manager approval and at least 2 competitive quotations.
A receipt is required for expenses of R$50 or more.
The Travel Policy specifies rules for flights, hotel rates, meal limits, and reasonable ground transportation.
The provided Travel Policy does not specify a daily reimbursement limit for airport parking.
The Remote Work Policy defines hybrid remote-work limits, temporary exceptions, international remote-work requirements, and core working hours.
The provided Remote Work and Expense policies do not specify reimbursement for coworking-space fees.
The Leave Policy specifies annual leave and emergency personal leave rules.
The provided Leave Policy does not specify parental-leave entitlement or duration.
For purchases above R$5,000, Asteria Systems requires manager approval, Procurement approval, at least 3 competitive quotations, and a Purchase Order before commitment.
The Employee Policy Assistant cannot approve purchases, select a supplier, issue a Purchase Order, authorize payment, or alter procurement thresholds.
Leave requests are reviewed by the employee's manager.
Submitting a leave request does not mean that the leave has been approved.
The Employee Policy Assistant cannot approve leave requests.
The maximum reimbursable hotel rate for domestic travel is R$450 per night.
A domestic hotel rate above R$450 per night requires written director approval.
The maximum reimbursable hotel rate for international travel is R$800 per night.
An international hotel rate above R$800 per night requires written director approval.
Eligible employees may work remotely up to 2 days per week and must work from the office at least 3 days per week.
Unused remote-work days do not carry over.
A temporary remote-work exception may be approved for up to 10 consecutive business days.
A temporary remote-work exception requires approval from the employee's manager and People Ops.
